title: Disaster from the North

questions.question: "Declare in Judah, and proclaim in Jerusalem, and say, 'Blow the... through the land; cry aloud and say, Assemble, and let us go into the fortified cities!'"

questions.explanation: Jeremiah 4:6 (ESV): "for I bring disaster from the north, and great destruction."

questions.question: "For my people are foolish; they know me not; they are stupid children; they have no understanding. They are 'wise'—in doing..., but how to do good they know not."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 4:22 (ESV): "They are 'wise'—in doing evil! But how to do good they know not."

questions.question: Jeremiah says, "I looked on the earth, and behold, it was without form and void; and to the heavens, and they had no..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 4:23 (ESV): "I looked on the earth, and behold, it was without form and void; and to the heavens, and they had no light."

questions.question: "For thus says the Lord, 'The whole land shall be a desolation; yet I will not make a... end.'"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 4:27 (ESV): "yet I will not make a full end."

key_verse_text: O Jerusalem, wash your heart from evil, that you may be saved. How long shall your wicked thoughts lodge within you?
